_comment: Facts read on 2026-10-24 from each school's own website (the page named in 'source'). Only columns listed here are changed.

Bal Bhavan Public School.note: The school's website states that its Mayur Vihar branch offers education from Nursery to Class 12.

Dashmesh Public School.note: The school's website states a strength of around 4,500 students and 245 faculty members.

Kerala Education Society Sr. Sec. School.note: Run by the Kerala Education Society (registered 1958); the school states it was established in 1996 and recognised by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi in 1999.

Lovely Heritage School.note: The school's website states it offers education from nursery to class 12 and is part of the Lovely group of schools.

Mother Mary's School.note: The school describes itself as a CBSE girls' day school on Sahkarita Marg, established in 2006, serving over 2,800 students from Pre-Primary through Class XII (Pre-Primary recorded as KG).

Salwan Public School Mayur Vihar.note: The school describes itself as a co-educational senior secondary school under the Salwan Education Trust, established on 5 August 1996, with around 1,650 students and 81 teachers; admissions run from Nursery (Balvatika-I); its admissions page covers transport and meal facilities.

St. Mary's Secondary School Mayur Vihar.note: A Catholic minority school founded in 1996 under the Delhi Catholic Archdiocese, administered by the C.J. Sisters. The school states it is co-educational and English-medium with classes 1 to 12 and a pre-primary section.

Vanasthali Public School.school_timings: 8:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. or 2:00 p.m., depending on the section (summer and winter)
Vanasthali Public School.note: The school describes itself as a co-educational minority school established in 2002 and recognised by the Department of Education, Govt. of NCT of Delhi. Timings from https://www.vpsphase3.com/school-timing.

Vidya Bal Bhavan Senior School.note: The school's website lists Nursery and Pre-Primary admissions and transport routes; CBSE lists it at senior secondary level (Pre-Primary recorded as KG).
